# Pro Niñez Panamá — App Repository Context

> Title: Pro Niñez Panamá Longitudinal Early Childhood Impact Study Application
> Stack: Next.js 14 (App Router, Standalone), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Admin SDK, IndexedDB PWA.
> Target Deployment: Coolify PaaS on mel-vps (Docker).
> Primary Sponsor: Fundación Banco General
> Technical Implementation: One Clik To Go

## Key Rules & Constraints
1. LEY 285 PANAMA PRIVACY COMPLIANCE:
   - Child PII (nombre_completo, cedula) MUST BE physically and logically decoupled from academic performance records (EGRA, EGMA, SDQ).
   - Identity mapping MUST only happen via restricted `/api/admin/match-estudiante` route, enforcing `ADMIN` JWT role.
   - Evaluator and Donor roles MUST NEVER receive unmasked student PII.

2. OFFLINE-FIRST ARCHITECTURE:
   - Field evaluations are saved locally to IndexedDB when network connection is unavailable.
   - Pending evaluations are stored in `sync_queue` and ingested via `/api/evaluations/ingest` when online.

3. TECH DOMAIN CONCEPTS:
   - CET: Centro de Estimulación Temprana (Pro Niñez)
   - EGRA: Early Grade Reading Assessment (sub-scores: letras, lectura oral, comprension, fluidez)
   - EGMA: Early Grade Math Assessment (sub-scores: numeracion, conteo, operaciones, logica)
   - SDQ: Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (socioemotional rating)

4. DIRECTORY MAP:
   - `/src/app/api/admin/match-estudiante/route.ts`: Admin PII resolution API
   - `/src/app/api/evaluations/ingest/route.ts`: Evaluation batch ingestion API
   - `/src/app/api/students/route.ts`: Anonymous student CRUD API
   - `/src/app/api/dashboard/stats/route.ts`: Aggregated analytics API
   - `/src/lib/firebase/admin.ts`: Firebase Admin SDK
   - `/src/lib/firebase/db.ts`: Firestore helper queries & seed generator
   - `/src/lib/offline/db.ts`: IndexedDB queue client
   - `/src/lib/auth/rbac.ts`: Token & RBAC enforcement
   - `/src/middleware.ts`: Next.js edge route protection middleware
